name: Meatballs & Tomato Sauce with Zucchini Spaghetti

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince onion. Peel and mince garlic. Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
9 cloves garlic
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, combine beef, eggs, bread crumbs, ½ of the onion, ½ of the garlic, cumin, basil, salt, pepper, and a ¼ of the minced parsley. Mix together.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
3 eggs
⅜ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ tsp cumin
3 tsp basil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Form beef mixture into small balls and place on a plate.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil and add meatballs. Turning occasionally, cook until browned but not cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate once done.
Once meatballs have been transferred, add more oil to skillet. Add remaining onion and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add remaining garlic and red pepper to skillet and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.

Add tomatoes, remaining parsley, oregano, basil, salt, and pepper. Mash tomatoes with a potato masher. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, add meatballs, and simmer until meatballs are cooked through, 5-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
¾ tsp oregano
¾ tsp basil
1 ½ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash zucchini, trim ends, and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles.
To serve, place zucchini noodles in a bowl, top with meatballs and sauce, and enjoy!
